Funny enough, I had an idea similar to this sometime in October or thereabouts:

Basically, you'd play as a lawyer tasked by the government with defending an individual from (false) allegations of harassment. The twist is that the client would be one who was openly involved in a subculture revolving around a type of nonfatal drug, the subculture being one that has come under heavy fire from the media. As a result, in the back of the lawyer's head, he would presume that his client was guilty, and that he was merely attempting to fabricate a case to "prove" that his client was innocent. However, as the game progresses, the lawyer takes a critical look at the evidence and determines that not only is his client innocent (eventually turning his work from that of mandate to one stemming from a genuine desire for justice), but finding out that the subculture is one that isn't what the media makes it out to be.
